items.name: utils
items.title: Utils
items.description: Class-name merge helper shared by every Oxygen component.

items.name: tokens
items.title: Oxygen tokens
items.description: Semantic clinical status tokens, three density modes, and light/dark themes. Required by every Oxygen component.

items.name: patient-banner
items.title: Patient Banner
items.description: Persistent patient identity header driven by a FHIR R4 Patient resource. Handles restricted records, deceased status, masked identifiers, and missing demographics.

items.name: vitals-panel
items.title: Observation Panel
items.description: Results table for FHIR R4 Observation resources. Renders values, units, reference ranges, and interpretation — with uninterpreted results shown as uninterpreted, never as normal.
